title: Model presets
subtitle: Reusable model access for API keys that stays current as models and providers change.
empty: Create a preset to give keys a curated set of models in one step, for example only zero data retention models or only EU-hosted models.
readOnly: You can view presets. Changing them requires the models:manage permission.

rule.retention: {days, plural, =0 {No retention} one {Retention ≤ # day} other {Retention ≤ # days}}
rule.removed: {count, plural, one {# removed provider} other {# removed providers}}

matchCount: {count, plural, =0 {No models} one {# model} other {# models}}

preset.label: Start from
preset.option: {preset, select, zdr {Zero data retention} eu {EU data residency} noTraining {No training on prompts} shortRetention {Retention up to 30 days} other {Blank}}
preset.name: {preset, select, zdr {Zero data retention} eu {EU only} noTraining {No training} shortRetention {Retention up to 30 days} other {}}

fields.name: Name
fields.rulesHint: A model qualifies when at least one endpoint behind it, also through fallback and overflow aliases, meets every rule. Requests from keys with this preset only use those endpoints.
fields.patternsHint: Comma-separated. * matches anything, for example claude-*, gpt-4o*.
fields.regionsHint: Only endpoints whose provider processes data in one of the selected regions.
fields.retentionHint: Leave empty for no limit. Providers without a stated retention never match.
fields.retentionInvalid: Enter whole days from 0 to {max, number, integer}.
fields.zdrOnlyHint: Only providers marked with a zero data retention agreement.
fields.noTrainingOnlyHint: Only providers that do not use prompts or outputs for training.
fields.modelsHint: Added regardless of the rules above.

removed.title: {count, plural, one {A selected provider was removed} other {# selected providers were removed}}
removed.description: {count, plural, one {No endpoint matches it anymore, so it never widens access.} other {No endpoint matches them anymore, so they never widen access.}} With no provider selected, every provider qualifies.

preview.title: Preview
preview.summary: {count, plural, =0 {This preset matches no model right now.} one {This preset allows # model.} other {This preset allows # models.}}
preview.empty: Add a rule or a model to define the preset.

deleteHint: No API key uses this preset. This cannot be undone.
deleteInUse: {count, plural, one {Remove it from # key first.} other {Remove it from # keys first.}}
